core_obligations: Fix a geometric point xbar of X with images ybar in Y and zbar in Z (proof lines 6521-6524).
Use the flatness characterisations and the stalk description to reduce the lemma to a statement about the chain O_Z -> O_Y -> O_X and the module G_ybar (proof lines 6524-6534).
Conclude with the algebraic flatness descent statement (proof lines 6535-6536).
Derive the 'in particular' clause from the pointwise equivalence by surjectivity of f (proof lines 6516-6518).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for morphisms f : X -> Y and g : Y -> Z of algebraic spaces over S, a quasi-coherent G on Y and a point x of |X| with image y, flatness of f at x makes flatness of G over Z at y equivalent to flatness of f^*G over Z at x; in particular, for f surjective and flat the two global flatness statements are equivalent (source lines 6505-6519). The proof reduces the claim to algebra by fixing a geometric point of X over x, applying the two flatness-at-a-point characterisations and the description of the stalk of the pullback, so that the statement becomes one about the chain of local ring maps O_Z -> O_Y -> O_X and the module G_y, which is a standard flatness descent statement.
